comparison.objective: Refit and lock a refrigerator door bin onto two hidden supports; no material separation objective.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level carrying, tight-clearance alignment, simultaneous support engagement and downward seating, versus controlled sifting of loose bodies through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Both bin ends engaged and pushed home, bin level, released and still for 1 s. Candidate instead requires ≥98% media recovery, complete washer retention, two-support reseating, clearance and 3 s dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual load sharing and reseating on two supports, but the tested abilities differ meaningfully: precision fixture engagement versus orientation-sensitive selective many-body separation.
